title: Off on a Comet! a Journey through Planetary Space
sourceTitle: Off on a Comet! a Journey through Planetary Space
author: Jules Verne
longDescription: a Journey through Planetary Space" by Jules Verne is a science fiction novel published in 1877. When a comet strikes Earth near Gibraltar, 36 people from various nations are carried away into space on fragments of the planet.

authorInfo.bio: Jules Verne (1828–1905) is the credited author of this historical edition. Works available in this collection include Around the World in Eighty Days, A Journey to the Centre of the Earth, The Mysterious Island, From the Earth to the moon; and, round the moon. The linked author record provides further bibliographic details.
